Wire each `.claude/hooks/*.selftest.sh` into this repo's CI (workflow edit only — the hooks themselves are governed surface and are NOT touched). The objectstack half is filed as objectstack-ai/objectstack#11514.

Open PRs and their surfaces, all disjoint: #5988 (`scripts/__tests__/scripts-type-check.test.ts`), #5989 (`apps/console/src/__tests__/`), #5991 (`content/docs/guide/{component-registry,layout}.md` + the doc-snippet ledger), #5995 (`scripts/vite-objectstack-spec-dist.ts`). Co-dispatched R9: #4938 (`check-doc-links.mjs`), #4964 (i18n gate), #4991 (`packages/cli/src/__tests__/app-generator.test.ts`), #4996 (`shadcn-local-patches`). ⚠️ **#4938 is the only other card that could plausibly want a workflow — it must not add one**, and neither may you add a second; one inventory write per round.

## PM-verified premise on `origin/main` @ `53dc89db8`

- **No workflow references `selftest`** — zero hits across `.github/workflows/`. Premise holds.
- **Control** (so the zero is a reading, not a broken query): the scripts exist — `.claude/hooks/guard-main-checkout-bash.selftest.sh` and `.claude/hooks/guard-shared-stash.selftest.sh`.

So two PreToolUse guards that both `CLAUDE.md` files call load-bearing have **self-tests nothing ever runs**. A broken guard lands green — and `CLAUDE.md` explicitly instructs agents to re-run `guard-shared-stash.selftest.sh` after changing that hook, an instruction no gate backs.

## Rulings (⛔ not re-adjudicable)

- ⛔ **Do not modify the hooks or their self-tests.** `.claude/**` is a **governed surface** — touching it makes this PR draft-only and human-merge for no benefit. You are adding a **runner**, not changing what is run. If a self-test is itself broken, **stop and report** rather than fixing it here.
- **Both paired writes are mandatory** and both have live precedent from **PR #5984, merged 11:16Z today**: the `ci-cd-pipeline.md` inventory pin (`scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts`) and classifying the new check in `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs`. Read how #5984 did it and follow that shape.
- The runner must **fail the build when a self-test fails**. A gate that reports and exits 0 reproduces the defect.

## Zone 2 — measure

- **Run both self-tests yourself first.** If either is already failing on `main`, that is a finding to report **before** you wire it up — landing a runner that immediately reddens `main` is the worst outcome here.
- State the runtime cost. These are shell self-tests; if they are fast, say how fast, so a reviewer can see the trade.

## Gates

No `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` here — derive from your diff. Expect `scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` and `scripts/__tests__/dependabot-merge-gate.test.ts` to go **red before** you make the paired writes (that is them working). Plus `scripts/__tests__`, Lint. Run `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, follow its verdict; ⛔ no `skip-changeset` label (#4912/#3724).

⚠️ Restore idiom (objectstack#11648): `git checkout <ref> -- <path>` writes the **INDEX**; a trap with bare `git checkout -- <path>` reads the mutation back and **exits 0**. Use `git checkout HEAD -- <path>`, prove with `git diff HEAD`.

Draft PR, `Fixes #5754`, report as an issue comment with the `<!-- os-dev-report -->` marker (⚠️ the sanitizer has stripped it repeatedly today — read back, repost as literal text if so).

## ACCEPT — PR #6022, with one verification gap recorded. Landing on CI convergence.

Reviewer of record: `domain:devx` @ objectui seat (#5748), round **R9**, PM session `session_019b5UBNMtTzKbVtZZGvFuxe`. **Verified against the branch — ⛔ not against the report.** Scope: 4 files (new workflow, `ci-cd-pipeline.md`, `dependabot-merge-gate.mjs`, changeset).

### Zone 2 discharged before wiring, as required

Both self-tests measured on `main` @ `53dc89db8` **before** anything was added:

| self-test | result | runtime |
|:--|:--|--:|
| `guard-main-checkout-bash.selftest.sh` | 100 passed, 0 failed | 3.198s |
| `guard-shared-stash.selftest.sh` | 32 passed, 0 failed | 0.637s |

Both already green, so ⛔ no pre-existing red is being wired into `main` — the outcome the dispatch most wanted ruled out. ~3.8s total is a negligible gate cost, and it is stated rather than left for a reviewer to guess.

### Governed surface respected

⛔ `.claude/**` untouched. The workflow header states the boundary itself: *"This is a RUNNER, not a rewrite of what it runs … If a self-test is ever found broken, that is a finding for a separate PR against the governed surface, not something to patch here."* That is the ruling, restated where the next reader will find it.

### The path-filter decision is argued, not assumed

The header does something I did not ask for and which earns the opus-grade write-up: it **compares against `control-bytes.yml`'s explicit decision NOT to path-filter**, and explains why that reasoning does not transfer — control bytes can enter through a markdown-only PR, whereas these self-tests build hermetic git fixtures asserting the **current hook script's** behaviour, so only a change to the hooks (or the workflow) can regress them.

⚠️ That matters because path-filtering a gate is normally a way to *weaken* it, and this repo has a documented precedent pointing the other way. Meeting that precedent head-on instead of silently diverging is the difference between a judgement and an omission.

The `dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` classification is correspondingly correct: it sits with `Changeset Bump Policy` and `Bundle Analysis` as a **path-filtered check that blocks when it runs and is simply absent otherwise** — accurate, since a Dependabot bump never touches `.claude/hooks/**`.

### ⚠️ Verification gap — recorded, not waved through

The dispatch said to expect `ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` and `dependabot-merge-gate.test.ts` to go **RED before** the paired writes, since that red is the evidence those pins actually enforce the inventory. **That red was not captured** — the workflow and both paired writes were authored together, so the pre-pairing state was never observed.

Accepted rather than sent back, because the claim is independently supported: **PR #5984 hit exactly those two pins going red this morning** when it added a workflow, so the pins are known-live in this repo today, and both are green now against the completed diff. ⛔ But it is a missing measurement, not a satisfied one, and a future workflow-adding card should stage it so the red is seen.

### Minor deviation

An empty-frontmatter changeset was added although `check-changeset-presence.mjs` said **none was owed** ("CI-only change"), on the grounds of repo convention. Harmless — empty frontmatter releases nothing — but ⚠️ it is doing something the gate did not ask for, and the standing instruction is to **follow the gate's verdict**. Not worth a round trip; noted so it does not calcify into "always add one".

### What this card actually closes

Two PreToolUse guards that both `CLAUDE.md` files call binding had self-test matrices **nothing ever ran** — `CLAUDE.md` even instructs agents to re-run `guard-shared-stash.selftest.sh` after touching that hook, an instruction no gate backed. A fail-open regression would have silently stopped guarding the shared checkout; a fail-closed one would have trained operators onto `OS_ALLOW_MAIN_EDITS=1`. Neither would have shown up in a PR. Now both do.

### Landing

`.github/workflows/**`, `content/docs/**`, `scripts/**`, `.changeset/**` — **not** governed surface. Maintainer's ruling, 2026-08-24, verbatim: 「授权 auto-merge（推荐）」 — every check green, ⛔ not the `required` subset.
